record.paper_title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems
record.original_question: Determine whether there exists a natural number S such that every integer other than 1 appears in Pascal’s triangle at most S times.

evidence.quote: Problem 33 (Singmaster’s conjecture). There is a value S∈N such that any number diﬀerent from 1 appears in the Pascal’s triangle at most S times.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Pascal's triangle is the infinite array of binomial coefficients $\binom{n}{k}$ for integers $0 \le k \le n$. The number $1$ occurs infinitely often (as $\binom{n}{0}=\binom{n}{n}=1$). For every integer $m \ge 2$, let $N(m)$ denote the number of pairs $(n,k)$ with $0 \le k \le n$ such that $\binom{n}{k} = m$.

Determine whether there exists a natural number $S$ such that $N(m) \le S$ for every integer $m \ge 2$. Equivalently, prove or disprove that the multiplicities of entries other than $1$ in Pascal's triangle are uniformly bounded.
artifact.status_search_result: Singmaster's conjecture (1971) remains open. The strongest known bound is $O((\log n)(\log\log n)^{-3})$ due to Kane (2007). Matomäki, Radziwiłł, Shao, Teräväinen, and Tao (2021) proved the conjecture holds in the interior region of Pascal's triangle, reducing the problem to the boundary region, but the full conjecture is unproven. It is not even known whether any binomial coefficient other than $1$ appears more than 8 times.

status_evidence.title: Singmaster's conjecture - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: It is not known whether any number appears more than eight times... The conjecture remains unproven.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is still open in general.

status_evidence.title: Singmaster's conjecture in the interior of Pascal's triangle
status_evidence.snippet: Matomäki, Radziwiłł, Shao, Teräväinen, Tao establish the conjecture in the interior region.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress: conjecture proven in interior region; boundary case remains.

status_evidence.title: Singmaster's conjecture in the interior of Pascal's triangle | What's new
status_evidence.snippet: To verify Singmaster's conjecture in full, it suffices to verify it in the boundary region.
